setup_guide.introduction: I'll produce an experimental CT research report and explain its wording and limits; this is not for real diagnosis, treatment or triage. Upload a de-identified .nii or .nii.gz file with +, then choose chest or abdomen; no scan is bundled. Work starts when those inputs are ready and the saved report appears in Chat.

real.introduction: Upload a de-identified CT volume and choose the anatomy present. The final required answer starts a research run; I'll explain the saved experimental report and its limitations in Chat.

fields.label: CT file
fields.description: Upload a de-identified 3D .nii or .nii.gz CT with Hounsfield units (64 MiB compressed, 256 MiB expanded maximum). Not for real diagnosis.

fields.label: Anatomy region
fields.description: Choose the region present in the uploaded CT.

fields.label: Saved instructions
fields.description: Manage explanation preferences in Chat > Memory. Scan inputs and research questions use setup controls.

starter_questions: What CT file and anatomy choice do you need?
Can you walk me through the report format before I upload?
Explain this saved report’s wording and coverage limits.
